BiblicalUsage: Abimelech asks Abraham to swear he will not deal falsely with him or with his son or his son's son, and the LORD promises to cut off from Babylon name and remnant and son and offspring.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the offspring is the promise and the judgment at once: Abimelech wants the line protected, and Babylon's line is cut off, and God keeps the seed of the faithful and ends the seed of the proud.
